coverage: Diagnostic spot review, not a complete semantic grading of 200 questions

findings.finding: Housing benefit overview now states 48% and distinguishes rental benefit from owner-occupied repair benefit. Previous diagnostic run prioritized amendment comparisons.

Answer incorrectly says the A-benefit formula is always applied above 250%. Retrieved source explicitly says 200%; 250% is a different formula parameter. The answer also omits the base pension amount despite retrieving its table.
findings.implication: A source hit and a complete answer format do not prove a correct relationship between numbers and rules.

findings.finding: Answer lists the existence of a system manual and FAQ rather than explaining system functions or clarifying that this is an administrative system, not a benefit programme.
A support-content question is answered mostly with eligibility rules and staff break replacement. Coverage of the beneficiary's principal services needs a dedicated answer rubric.

next_validation_requirements: Define beneficiary services, general eligibility, application procedure, exceptions and year applicability in the answer rubric for each programme.
Test percentage-to-rule relationships, not just presence of the same percentage somewhere in the retrieved evidence.
Create independent practitioner questions and review their answers without using them to tune the tested version.
Count incorrect, incomplete and unjustified abstaining answers as failures on answerable questions.
